# Utica Midstream

> A free daily read on oil and gas from wellhead to market: prices, stocks, pipelines, policy, projects and people, with every fact sourced and dated. Each edition has a price board (crude, gas, products and calculated spreads), market and stock notes, a lead story traced through upstream, midstream, downstream and the market, briefs by segment, a regulatory docket, basin watch, a weekly leader profile and an events calendar. General information, not investment advice.

## Today's edition
- [FERC approves Cheniere's three train Sabine Pass expansion and two new feed pipelines](https://uticamidstream.com/): November 20, 2026. FERC approved Cheniere's three train Sabine Pass LNG expansion in Louisiana on Thursday, about 20 million tonnes a year of new capacity, plus the Creole Trail and Sabine Crossing feed pipelines.
- [Midstream: Energy Transfer closes its $1.95 billion Vaquero Midstream purchase in the Delaware basin](https://uticamidstream.com/#money)
- [Cross-industry: IEA says Gulf bypass pipelines cannot end dependence on Hormuz](https://uticamidstream.com/#world)
- [Midstream: MPLX declares force majeure as Enbridge's Bakken line stays curtailed](https://uticamidstream.com/#bakken)
- [Downstream: Ukrainian strikes have cut Russian refinery runs by about 45%](https://uticamidstream.com/#russia)
- [Gas and LNG: US gas storage adds 20 Bcf, leaving stocks above average into winter](https://uticamidstream.com/#gas)
